summary: Richtech Robotics filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 21, 2026, disclosing receipt on September 18, 2026 of a statement of work under a Master Services Agreement dated August 25, 2025 with an unnamed national retailer. The SOW commits the client to purchase and deploy 200 DUST-E autonomous cleaning robots over five years, plus automated reporting and remote support services. No price, value, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory terms were disclosed. This is a routine commercial order, not a special situation; watch execution and revenue conversion.
